scope: Desktop working copy; backend resume endpoint and RCP job journal UI

change.backend: POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/jobs/{job_id}/resume resumes only failed/cancelled RCP batch jobs after validating durable task payload, project ownership, unique cloud IDs, station ownership, source availability and absence of active child jobs. The job row is reset transactionally and keeps its ID; worker logic skips already-ready clouds.
change.frontend: Failed RCP batch rows in the project job journal show a Возобновить action. The client reattaches progress observation after the same job is queued again.

verification.focused_resume_scenario: Passed: one station fails, standalone station retry succeeds, parent batch resumes, ready stations are skipped without duplicate clouds; resume is rejected while a child job is active and after successful completion.

limitations: The new Desktop source changes have not been deployed to the shared API process.
The live 810-station source project remains read-only and separate from the local test database.
ReCap GUI round-trip and the RCP-declared versus native-reader point-count difference remain unresolved; Stage 2 is not complete.
The one existing skipped test requires the absent prebuilt DWG release album.
